title: SGLayout: Schema-Guided Closed-Loop Refinement for LLM-Driven Parameterized Layout Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in parameterized layout generation via tool-augmented code synthesis. However, LLMs lack spatial awareness, making one-shot generation unreliable. While layout quality can be evaluated with established techniques, a critical gap remains: geometric-domain evaluation outcomes cannot be directly translated into actionable code-level fixes, trapping iterative refinement in blind refactoring. We propose SGLayout, a self-refining framework that closes this gap via a schema-guided mechanism. Upon code execution, a structured schema captures the correspondence between each code-level instance and its geometric attributes, establishing a bidirectional link between code space and geometry space. Emulating engineer review practices, SGLayout evaluates layouts along two complementary dimensions: intent compliance through quantitative structural checking and qualitative vision-language assess

translated_title: SGLayout：面向LLM驱动的参数化布局生成的模式引导闭环优化框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过工具增强的代码合成，在参数化布局生成方面展现出了强大的潜力。然而，LLM缺乏空间感知能力，使得一次性生成并不可靠。虽然布局质量可以通过已有技术进行评估，但仍存在一个关键缺口：几何领域的评估结果无法直接转化为可操作的代码级修复，使得迭代优化陷入盲目重构的困境。我们提出了SGLayout，一个通过模式引导机制弥合这一缺口的自优化框架。在代码执行后，结构化的模式（schema）会捕获每个代码级实例与其几何属性之间的对应关系，从而在代码空间和几何空间之间建立双向链接。通过模拟工程师的审查实践，SGLayout沿两个互补的维度评估布局：通过定量结构检查实现的意图合规性评估，以及定性的视觉-语言评估。
tldr: SGLayout提出了一种模式引导的自优化框架，通过结构化模式在代码空间与几何空间之间建立双向链接，将几何评估结果转化为可操作的代码级修复，解决了LLM参数化布局生成中迭代优化盲目重构的问题。
en_tdlr: SGLayout is a schema-guided self-refining framework that establishes a bidirectional link between code space and geometry space, translating geometric evaluation outcomes into actionable code-level fixes to enable closed-loop iterative refinement of LLM-driven parameterized layout generation.
